quote: For the moon though one, dispels the darkness, which the stars, though numerous, do not.
author: Chanakya

quote: For the protection of state and welfare of the people, a ruler shold collect all types of wealth. By suing devices of sama, dama, danda, bheda, he shold increase income of the state, strong administration helps in collecting different type of taxes fro exchequer.
author: Chanakya

quote: Generosity, pleasing address, courage and propriety of conduct are not acquired, but are inbred qualities.
author: Chanakya

quote: God doesn't dwell in the wooden, stony or earthen idols. His abode is in our feelings, our thoughts.
author: Chanakya

quote: God is not present in idols. Your feelings are your god. The soul is your temple.
author: Chanakya

quote: Good behavior wins even an enemy.
author: Chanakya

quote: He shall despise none, but hear the opinions of all. A wise man shall make use of even a child’s sensible utterance.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who befriends a man whose conduct is vicious, whose vision impure, and who is notoriously crooked, is rapidly ruined.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who forsakes his own community and joins another perishes as the king who embraces an unrighteous path.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who gives up shyness in monetary dealings, in acquiring knowledge, in eating and in business, becomes happy.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who has wealth has friends. In other words, all friendships and relationships are dictated by selfish motives.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who is overly attached to his family members, experiences fear and sorrow, for the root of all grief is attachment. Thus, one should discard attachment to be happy. As simple as that!
author: Chanakya

quote: Who is prepared for the future and he who deals cleverly with any situation that may arise are both happy; but the fatalistic man who wholly depends on luck is ruined.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who lives in our mind is near though he may actually be far away, but he who is not in our heart is far though he may really be nearby.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who loses his money is forsaken by his friends, his wife, his servants and his relations; yet when he regains his riches those who have forsaken him come back to him. Hence wealth is certainly the best of relations.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who nurtures benevolence for all creatures within his heart overcomes all difficulties and will be the recipient of all types of riches at every step.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who runs away from a fearful calamity, a foreign invasion, a terrible famine, and the companionship of wicked men is safe.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who shall practice these twenty virtues shall become invincible in all his undertakings.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who wears unclean garments, has dirty teeth, is a glutton, speaks unkindly and sleeps after sunrise – although he may be the greatest personality – will lose the favour of Lakshmi.
author: Chanakya

quote: Whose son is obedient to him, whose wife’s conduct is in accordance with his wishes, and who is content with his riches, has his heaven here on earth.
author: Chanakya

quote: How well u treat the wicked people, they do nto give up their wickedness. They derive pleasure in hurting others. A serpent made to drink milk, it ejects poison only.
author: Chanakya

quote: If a king is energetic, his subjects will be equally energetic. If he is reckless, they not only be reckless but also eat into his works.
author: Chanakya

quote: If a person does good to you, you should also do the same. Similarly, those who are wicked to you should also be treated in the same way. There is no harm in doing so.
author: Chanakya

quote: If one has a good disposition, what other virtue is needed? If a man has fame, what is the value of other ornamentation?
author: Chanakya

quote: If one limb of the body is defected or inflicted with, disease, the whole feels tha pai. Some way if any department, minister or official of the state is faulty, the whole country is effected. An administrator should try hard to curb it.
author: Chanakya

quote: If the bees which seek the liquid oozing from the head of a lust-intoxicated elephant are driven away by the flapping of his ears, then the elephant has lost only the ornament of his head. The bees are quite happy in the lotus filled lake.
author: Chanakya

quote: If the king is pious, the subjects become so; and if the king is vicious, the subjects become the same. If a king is indifferent to both (virtue and vice), then they too bear the same character. In short, as is the king, so are his subjects.
author: Chanakya

quote: If you were to choose between an evil person and a snake to keep company with, opt for the snake. Because the snake will bite you only in self-defense but the evil person will put a bite for any reason and any time or always.
author: Chanakya

quote: In trans-border relations, there are no permanent friends or permanent enemies or even permanent borders. There are only permanent interests and everything should be done to secure these interests.
author: Chanakya

quote: It is better to be without a king than to have a bad one.
author: Chanakya

quote: It is better to die than to preserve this life by incurring disgrace. The loss of life causes but a moment's grief, but disgrace brings grief every day of one's life.
author: Chanakya

quote: It is better to live under a tree in a jungle inhabited by tigers and elephants, to maintain oneself in such a place with ripe fruits and spring water, to lie down on grass and to wear the ragged barks of trees than to live amongst one's relations when reduced to poverty.
author: Chanakya

quote: It is narual for enemy to attack on the weaker side of the adversary.
author: Chanakya

quote: It is the mind of man alone that is the cause of his bondage or freedom.
author: Chanakya

quote: It's better to die than to preserve this life by incurring disgrace.
author: Chanakya

quote: Just as a mirror reflects as a man's face his personality is reflected in his choice of friends. One must always be careful in forming friendships and acquaintances, for one’s friends, are in a way, an extension of one’s inner inclinations and tendencies.
author: Chanakya

quote: Know your goals.
author: Chanakya

quote: Knower of the means makes impossible tasks also possible.
author: Chanakya

quote: Knowledge is lost without putting it into practice; a man is lost due to ignorance; an army is lost without a commander; and a woman is lost without a husband.
author: Chanakya

quote: Lakshmi, the Goddess of wealth, comes of Her own accord where fools are not respected, grain is well stored up, and the husband and wife do not quarrel.
author: Chanakya

quote: Learn from the mistakes of others. You can’t live long enough to make them all yourselves.
author: Chanakya

quote: Learning is a friend on the journey; a wife in the house; medicine in sickness; and religious merit is the only friend after death.
author: Chanakya

quote: Learning is like a cow of desire. It, like her, yields in all seasons. Like a mother, it feeds you on your journey. Therefore learning is a hidden treasure.
author: Chanakya

quote: Let not a single day pass without your learning a verse, half a verse, or a fourth of it, or even one letter of it; nor without attending to charity, study and other pious activity.
author: Chanakya

quote: Low minded people are fraudulent, wicked and chaeat. They shouldnot be trusted. To h ave faith in low minded ones is mistake in policy and useless because they are not trustworthy. An administrator should not invited calamity by trusting the low minded ones.
author: Chanakya

quote: Many a bad habit is developed through overindulgence, and many a good one by chastisement; therefore, beat your son as well as your pupil; never indulge them.
author: Chanakya

quote: Meditation is best performed when alone, education by two, singing by three, traveling with four persons, farming with five, and battle with as many as possible.
author: Chanakya

quote: Money comes and goes, so is the youth. Life goes and goes the soul, nothing lasts forever. The only thing that stays firm is your faith.
author: Chanakya

quote: Money earned must be circulated and put to good use similar to the water of a clean pond with inflow and outflow system. Whereas the water, logged in a pond is always dirty.
author: Chanakya

quote: Moral excellence is an ornament for personal beauty; righteous conduct, for high birth; success for learning; and proper spending for wealth.
author: Chanakya

quote: My dear child, if you desire to be free from the cycle of birth and death, then abandon the objects of sense gratification as poison. Drink instead the nectar of forbearance, upright conduct, mercy, cleanliness and truth.
author: Chanakya

quote: Never make friends with people who are above or below you in status. Such friendships will never give you any happiness.
author: Chanakya

quote: Never settle for anything less than what you deserve. It’s not pride, it’s self-respect.
author: Chanakya

quote: No amount of advice changes his attitude. He does not listen to good advice. Rather, he gets angry.
author: Chanakya

quote: No one can defeat a powerful mind.
author: Chanakya

quote: No one should ever be disrespected.
author: Chanakya

quote: Nothing comes without a price, not even friendship.
author: Chanakya

quote: O wise man! Give your wealth only to the worthy and never to others. The water of the sea received by the clouds is always sweet.
author: Chanakya

quote: Offspring, friends and relatives flee from a devotee of the Lord: yet those who follow him bring merit to their families through their devotion.
author: Chanakya

quote: Once you start a working on something, don't be afraid of failure and don't abandon it. People who work sincerely are the happiest.
author: Chanakya

quote: One destitute of wealth is not destitute, he is indeed rich, but the man devoid of learning is destitute in every way.
author: Chanakya

quote: One should fear only till he doesn’t know the reason for the fear. Once you find the reason for fear, then you should fight against it with courage.
author: Chanakya

quote: One who can't determine his goals; cannot win.
author: Chanakya

quote: One who is in search of knowledge should give up the search of pleasure and the one who is in search of pleasure should give up the search of knowledge.
author: Chanakya

quote: One who is to be pardoned should not be harassed.
author: Chanakya

quote: One whose knowledge is confined to books and whose wealth is in the possession of others can use neither knowledge nor wealth when the need arises.
author: Chanakya

quote: Our bodies are perishable, wealth is not at all permanent and death is always nearby. Therefore we must immediately engage in acts of merit.
author: Chanakya

quote: People’s Fury is above all the furies.
author: Chanakya

quote: Poverty, disease, sorrow, imprisonment and other evils are the fruits borne by the tree of one’s own sins.
author: Chanakya

quote: Prosperity lasts long for one who acts after proper consideration.
author: Chanakya

quote: Punishment when awarded with due consideration, makes the people devoted to righteousness and to works productive of wealth and enjoyment.
author: Chanakya

quote: Purity of speech, of the mind, of the senses, and of a compassionate heart are needed by one who desires to rise to the divine platform.
author: Chanakya

quote: Rain which falls upon the sea is useless; so is food for one who is satiated; in vain is a gift for one who is wealthy; and a burning lamp during the daytime is useless.
author: Chanakya

quote: Religion is preserved by wealth; knowledge by diligent practice; a king by conciliatory words; and a home by a dutiful housewife.
author: Chanakya

quote: Save your wealth against future calamity. Do not say, what fear has a rich man of calamity? Wealth sometimes vanishes away and large accumulations perish.
author: Chanakya

quote: Sinfully acquired wealth may remain for ten years; in the eleventh year it disappears with even the original stock.
author: Chanakya

quote: Skills are called hidden treasure as they save like a mother in a foreign country.
author: Chanakya

quote: Sometimes coincidentally an unintelligent person can accomplish a task but that does not mean that he is a knower of means and device or is experienced. A ruler should be careful enough to designate other tasks to such persons.
author: Chanakya

quote: Svanaja includes in itself the whole subject, officials and ministers. If there is something wrong in the conduct of these people, it would be damaging the state. An administrator should strictly deal with it.
author: Chanakya

quote: Swans live wherever there is water, and leave the place where water dries up; let not a man act so – he should not simply come and go as he pleases.
author: Chanakya

quote: Take risk in life , if you can’t take the risk then you will always be on the same position.
author: Chanakya

quote: Task performed by an unintelligent person should not be rated high.
author: Chanakya

quote: Test a servant while in the discharge of his duty, a relative in difficulty, a friend in adversity, and a wife in misfortune.
author: Chanakya

quote: That man who is without religion and mercy should be rejected. A guru without spiritual knowledge should be rejected. The wife with an offensive face should be given up, and so should relatives who are without affection.
author: Chanakya

quote: The beauty of a cuckoo is in its notes, that of a woman in her unalloyed devotion to her husband, that of an ugly person in his scholarship, and that of an ascetic in his forgiveness.
author: Chanakya

quote: The biggest guru mantra is: Never share your secrets with anybody. It will destroy you.
author: Chanakya

quote: The demerits of our own people bringh infamiy. Their disgrace is our own disgrace. That is why infamy os such people relly hurts. It is desifrable that the ruler or the administrator may work in a way that such disgraceful conduct may not occur.
author: Chanakya

quote: The disgrace of one’s people brings sorrow to the Nobel minded.
author: Chanakya

quote: The earth is supported by the power of truth it is the power of truth that makes the sun shine and the winds blow indeed all things rest upon truth.
author: Chanakya

quote: The fire of the forest burns trees to ashes. Even expensive sandalwood tree which is endowed with qualities of cooling and fragrance, cannot escape from burning. In the same way wicked cause harm to their benefactors also.
author: Chanakya

quote: The foolish wish to speak out what was spoken in secret by the master.
author: Chanakya

quote: The forest fire burns even trees like sandalwood.
author: Chanakya

quote: The fragrance of flowers spreads only in the direction of the wind. But the goodness of a person spreads in all direction.
author: Chanakya

quote: The Goddess of wealth is unsteady, and so is the life breath. The duration of life is uncertain, and the place of habitation is uncertain; but in all this inconsistent world religious merit alone is immovable.
author: Chanakya

quote: The happiness and peace attained by those satisfied by the nectar of spiritual tranquillity is not attained by greedy persons restlessly moving here and there.
author: Chanakya

quote: The house of a childless person is a void, all directions are void to one who has no relatives, the heart of a fool is also void, but to a poverty stricken man all is void.
author: Chanakya

quote: The king shall lose no time when the opportunity waited for arrives.
author: Chanakya

quote: The king shall singly deliberate over secret matters; for ministers have their own ministers, and these latter some of their own; this kind of successive line of ministers tends to the disclosure of counsels.
author: Chanakya

quote: The learned are envied by the foolish; rich men by the poor; chaste women by adulteresses; and beautiful ladies by ugly ones.
author: Chanakya

quote: The life of an uneducated man is as useless as the tail of a dog which neither covers its rear end nor protects it from bites of insects.
author: Chanakya

quote: The life, action, wealth, learning and death of a person are determined by God when he is in the womb itself..in short, it's pre-destined.
author: Chanakya

quote: The loss of life causes but a moment's grief, but disgrace brings grief every day of one's life.
author: Chanakya

quote: The low minded are fond of deception; the nature of low-minded people never changes.
author: Chanakya

quote: The man who is praised by others is regarded as worthy though he may be really void of all merit. But the man who sings his own praises becomes disgraced though he should be Indra, the possessor of all excellencies.
author: Chanakya

quote: The man who remains a fool even in advanced age is really a fool, just as the Indra-Varuna fruit does not become sweet no matter how ripe it might become.
author: Chanakya

quote: The one excellent thing that can be learned from a lion is that whatever a man intends doing should be done by him with a whole-hearted and strenuous effort.
author: Chanakya

quote: The one who has control over his mind is the one who is truly powerful.
author: Chanakya

quote: The poor wish for wealth; animals for the faculty of speech; men wish for heaven; and godly persons for liberation.
author: Chanakya

quote: The power of a king lies in his mighty arms; that of a brahmana in his spiritual knowledge; and that of a woman in her beauty youth and sweet words.
author: Chanakya

quote: The serpent, the king, the tiger, the stinging wasp, the small child, the dog owned by other people, and the fool: these seven ought not to be awakened from sleep.
author: Chanakya

quote: The test for purity of gold is performed by rubbing, heating, pounding, and cutting. Similarly, the true character of a person is revealed at the time of intense trouble. His manners, voice, and actions will reveal a lot about him.
author: Chanakya

quote: The wise man should restrain his senses like the crane and accomplish his purpose with due knowledge of his place, time and ability.
author: Chanakya

quote: The world's biggest power is the beauty and the youth of a woman.
author: Chanakya

quote: There are only two ways of dealing with evil persons or thorns. Crush them under your boot or stay far away from them.
author: Chanakya

quote: There is no austerity equal to a balanced mind, and there is no happiness equal to contentment there is no disease like covetousness, and no virtue like mercy.
author: Chanakya

quote: There is no austerity equal to a balanced mind, and there is no happiness equal to contentment; there is no disease like covetousness, and no virtue like mercy.
author: Chanakya

quote: There is no disease so destructive as lust.
author: Chanakya

quote: There is no enemy like infatuation and fire like wrath.
author: Chanakya

quote: There is no water like rainwater; no strength like one’s own; no light like that of the eyes; and no wealth more dear than food grain.
author: Chanakya

quote: There is poison in the fang of the serpent, in the mouth of the fly and in the sting of a scorpion; but the wicked man is saturated with it.
author: Chanakya

quote: There is some self-interest behind every friendship. There is no friendship without self-interests. This is a bitter truth.
author: Chanakya

quote: This world is a bitter tree, it has only two sweet nectar like fruits – one is soft voice and the other is company of gentlemen.
author: Chanakya

quote: Those base men who speak of the secret faults of others destroy themselves like serpents that stray onto anthills.
author: Chanakya

quote: Those born blind cannot see; similarly blind are those in the grip of lust. Proud men have no perception of evil; and those bent on acquiring riches see no sin in their actions.
author: Chanakya

quote: Those parents who do not educate their sons are their enemies; for as is a crane among swans, so are ignorant so are ignorant sons in a public assembly.
author: Chanakya

quote: Till the enemy’s weakness is known, he should be kept on friendly terms.
author: Chanakya

quote: Time is the most powerful and the most valuable thing in the world.
author: Chanakya

quote: Time perfects all living beings as well as kills them; it alone is awake when all others are asleep. Time is insurmountable.
author: Chanakya

quote: Time perfects men as well as destroys them.
author: Chanakya

quote: Too much beauty got Sita kidnapped, too much ego got Ravana killed and too much charity got Raja Bali in deep trouble. So too much of anything is bad. One should refrain from ‘too much’.
author: Chanakya

quote: Treat your kid like a darling for the first five years. For the next five years, scold them. By the time they turn sixteen treat them like a friend. Your grown up children are your best friends.
author: Chanakya

quote: Trees on a riverbank, a woman in another man’s house, and kings without counselors go without doubt to swift destruction.
author: Chanakya

quote: Use money acc. to time , place and its utility
author: Chanakya

quote: Use money before it gets rusty. Use it in investment , safety or alms.
author: Chanakya

quote: Virtuous persons and fruit-laden trees bow, but fools and dry sticks break because they do not bend.
author: Chanakya

quote: Water is the medicine for indigestion; it is invigorating when the food that is eaten is well digested; it is like nectar when drunk in the middle of a dinner; and it is like poison when taken at the end of a meal.
author: Chanakya

quote: We should always speak what would please the man of whom we expect a favour, like the hunter who sings sweetly when he desires to shoot a deer.
author: Chanakya

quote: We should not feel pride in our charity, austerity, valour, scriptural knowledge, modestyandmorality for the world is full of the rarest gems.
author: Chanakya

quote: We should not fret for the past, nor should we be anxious about the future. Men of discernment deal only with the present moment.
author: Chanakya

quote: Wealth, a friend, a wife, and a kingdom may be regained, but this body when lost may never be acquired again.
author: Chanakya

quote: What good can the scriptures do to a man who has no sense of his own? Of what use is as mirror to a blind man?
author: Chanakya

quote: What good is a cow that neither gives milk nor conceives? Similarly, what is the value of the birth of a son if he becomes neither learned nor a pure devotee of the Lord?
author: Chanakya

quote: What is the purpose of having a son who is neither learned nor devoted to God? It is useless to have a blind eye which will only result in eye-ache.
author: Chanakya

quote: When one is consumed by the sorrows of life, three things give him relief: offspring, a wife, and the company of the Lord’s devotees.
author: Chanakya

quote: When one is in an alien land, learning is a friend. When one is staying at home, one's mother is a friend. For one suffering from illness, medicine is a friend. And for the departed souls, dharma is a friend.
author: Chanakya

quote: Who realises all the happiness he desires? Everything is in the hands of God. Therefore one should learn contentment.
author: Chanakya

quote: Whoever imposes severe punishment becomes repulsive to the people; while he who awards mild punishment becomes contemptible. But whoever imposes punishment as deserved becomes respectable.
author: Chanakya

quote: Whores don’t live in company of poor men, citizens never support a weak company and birds don’t build nests on a tree that doesn’t bear fruits.
author: Chanakya

quote: Wicked ones are like fire. Even if pu on hea, they burn only. They do not leave unhurt even their well – wishers and benefactors.
author: Chanakya

quote: Women have hunger two-fold, shyness four-fold, daring six-fold, and lust eight-fold as compared to men.
author: Chanakya

quote: Your best teacher is your last mistake.
author: Chanakya

quote: Your feelings are your god.
author: Chanakya

quote: आत्मा किसी काल में भी न जन्मता है और न मरता है और न यह एक बार होकर फिर अभावरूप होने वाला है।आत्मा अजन्मा, नित्य, शाश्वत और पुरातन है, शरीर के नाश होने पर भी इसका नाश नहीं होता।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते।न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति॥ ३-४
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A disciplined mind brings happiness.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A gift is pure when it is given from the heart to the right person at the right time and at the right place, and when we expect nothing in return.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A gift is pure when it is given from the heart to the right person at the right time and at the right place, and when we expect nothing in return. (17:20)
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A gift is pure when it is given from the heart to the right person at the right time and place, expecting nothing in return.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A gift is pure when it is given from the heart to the right person at the right time and right place, and when we expect nothing in return.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A man engaged in devotional service rids himself of both good and bad actions even in this life. Therefore, strive for yoga, which is the art of all work.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person can rise through the efforts of his own mind; he can also degrade himself. The mind is the friend of the conditioned soul, and his enemy as well.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person can rise through the efforts of his own mind; or draw himself down in the same manner. Because each person is his own friend or enemy.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person can rise through the efforts of his own mind; or draw himself down, in the same manner. Because each person is his own friend or enemy.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person is considered still further advanced when he regards honest well-wishers, affectionate benefactors, the neutral, mediators, the envious, friends and enemies, the pious and the sinners all with an equal mind.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person is made by their belief. As they believe, so they become.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person is said to be elevated in yoga when, having renounced all material desires, he neither acts for sense gratification nor engages in fruitive activities.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person is said to be established in self-realization and is called a yogi when he is fully satisfied by virtue of acquired knowledge and realization.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A person is said to have achieved yoga, the union with the Self when the perfectly disciplined mind gets freedom from all desires.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: A true yogi observes me in all beings and also sees every being in me. Indeed, the self-realized person sees me, the same Supreme Lord, everywhere.- 6.29
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Aapne aap ko chhodkar, man kisi cheez ke bare mein sochne ke aisehi purane tareeke se sochta rahta hai. Lekin, man ko train karke, koi bhi apni soch ke purane tarike ko badal sakta hai; yeh yoga ka mukhya siddhant hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Aatm-nipunata ke lie sangharsh jo pratyek manushy ko karana hoga yadi use jeevan mein vijayee hona hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Aatm-tatva mein sthit log apne indriyon ko sambhaalte hain, indriyon se nahi sambhaale jaate.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Aatma na to janmatee hai aur na hee maratee hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Aatma, jis shakhaatmak sharir mein hai, woh aadi se hai, ashthavya hai, aur anant hai. Bas sharir hi hota hai jo vaastavik roop se nashvar hota hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Actions do not cling to me because I am not attached to their results. Those who understand this and practice it live in freedom.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: All happiness in the material world has a beginning and an end, but happiness in Krishna is unlimited, and there is no end.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: All the Upanishads are cows, Lord Krishna is the Cowherd, Arjuna is the wise Calf and the nectar of the Bhagavadgītā is the greatest Milk.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: All these performers who know the meaning of sacrifice become cleansed of sinful reactions, and, having tasted the nectar of the results of sacrifices, they advance toward the supreme eternal atmosphere.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Among all kinds of killers, time is the ultimate because time kills everything.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: An embodied being cannot renounce all action. But one who renounces the fruits of action is said to have truly renounced.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: An intelligent person does not take part in the sources of misery, which are due to contact with the material senses. O son of Kuntī, such pleasures have a beginning and an end, and so the wise man does not delight in them.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: And of all yogīs, the one with great faith who always abides in Me, thinks of Me within himself and renders transcendental loving service to Me – he is the most intimately united with Me in yoga and is the highest of all. That is My opinion.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: And when the yogī engages himself with sincere endeavour in making further progress, being washed of all contaminations, then ultimately, achieving perfection after many, many births of practice, he attains the supreme goal.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Apne ahankar mein mat ghul jao aur is baat se mat pareshan ho ki cheezein tumhari ichha ke anusaar chalen; tabhi hi tum karma ke bhayanak jaal mein nahi padoge. Karma se bhagane ki ummid karke apne dharm ka kaam karne se mat bacho: duniya mein jeene ke liye, humein kaam karna hoga.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Apne apne bhagya ko ashubh se jeena achha hai, kisine aur ke jeevan ka mukhiyat se jeena pariksha ke saath.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Apne liye kaam ko aasan banao. Sachaar aur iss pal mein jeeo. Aapke rozmarra ke kaam aapke khushi ko nahi chheene chahiye.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Arjuna, he who does not follow the wheel of creation set of going in this world, (i.e. does not perform his duties), sinful and sensual; he lives in pain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: As a man casts off worn-out garments and puts on others that are new,so does the soul cast off its worn-out bodies and enter into others that are new.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: As a strong wind sweeps away a boat on the water, even one of the roaming world of the senses on which the mind focuses can carry away a man’s intellect.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: As the heat of a fire reduces wood to ashes, the fire of knowledge burns to ashes all karma.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: As the ignorant perform their duties with attachment to results, the learned may similarly act, but without attachment, for the sake of leading people on the right path.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: As the kindled fire consumes the fuel, so in the flame of wisdom, the embers of action are burnt to ashes.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Atma-gyan apne man mein dvandvaas ke sabhi karmo ko bhasma kar deta hai aur aapko inner shanti deta hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Attachment breeds desire, desire breeds anger, anger breeds delusion, delusion breeds loss of memory, and loss of memory leads to the destruction of discernment. (2:62-63)
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Attraction and repulsion are ordained with regard to the objects of all the organs. One should not come under the sway of these two, because they are his adversaries.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Be aware of me always, adore me, make every act an offering to me, and you shall come to me; this I promise; for you are dear to me.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Be fearless and pure; never waver in your determination or your dedication to the spiritual life. Give freely. Be self-controlled, sincere, truthful, loving, and full of the desire to serve.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Being nourished by sacrifices, the gods will indeed give you the coveted enjoyments. He is certainly a thief who enjoys what has been given by them without offering to them.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Better is one’s own duty though devoid of merit than the duty of another well discharged.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: By abstaining from work no one attains freedom from action; nor does he rise to perfection by merely renouncing work.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: By being established in Yoga, O Dhananjaya, undertake actions, casting off attachmentand remaining equipoised in success and failure. Equanimity is called Yoga.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: By self-control and by renouncing all attachments, the willful soul enjoys tranquility.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Calmness, gentleness, silence, self-restraint, and purity: these are the disciplines of the mind.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Causes and results, including emotional opposites, are things that come and go. This knowledge helps you endure them all.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Change is the law of the universe. You can be a king or a pauper in an instant.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Change is the law of the universe. You can be a millionaire or a pauper in an instant.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Charity given to a worthy person simply because it is right to give, without consideration of anything in return, at the proper time and in the proper place, is stated to be in the mode of goodness.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Cultivate vigor, patience, will, purity; avoid malice and pride.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Curving back within myself, I create again and again.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Death is as sure for that which is born, as birth is for that which is dead. Therefore grieve not for what is inevitable.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Death is certain for the born, and re-birth is certain for the dead; therefore you should not feel grief for what is inevitable.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Death is no more traumatic than taking off an old coat.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Dekhate ya sunate, chhoote ya soonghate hue; khaate hue, chalate-phirate, ya sote hue; saans lete ya bolate hue, chhodate hue ya pakadate hue, yahaan tak ki aankhen kholate ya band karate hue, ve samajhate hain ki ye indriy vishayon ke beech keval indriyon kee gatividhiyaan hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Delusion arises from anger. The mind is bewildered by delusion. Reasoning is destroyed when the mind is bewildered.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Dheere dheere se practice karne se jo khushi aati hai, jo dukh khatam kar deti hai, jo shuru mein zeher jaisi lagti hai, lekin phir amrit jaisi lagti hai – iss prakaar ki khushi apne man ki shanti se uthti hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Dheere dheere se practice karne se jo sukh aata hai, jo dukh khatam kar deta hai, jo shuru mein zeher jaisa lagta hai, lekin phir amrit jaisa lagta hai – is prakaar ka sukh apne man ki shanti se uthta hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Dhruvta prayatna se aur bahut saare janm ke baad, koi vyakti apne sabhi svabhavik ichchhaon se shuddh ho jaata hai aur jeevan ka param uddeshya praapt karta hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Die, and you will win heaven; conquer, and you will enjoy sovereignty of the earth; therefore, stand up Arjuna, determined to fight.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Do not get attached to the people you love, because they are not permanent. Be attached to the love that flows through them, which is eternal.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Do your work with the welfare of others always in mind.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Doubtful log ke liye na toh yeh duniya hai, na parlok hai, aur na hi khushi hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Earth, water, fire, air, akasha, mind, intellect, and ego – these are the eight divisions of my prakriti.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Elevate yourself through your own efforts, and not degrade yourself. For, the mind can be the friend and also the enemy of the self.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Endowed with equanimity, one sheds in this life both good and evil. Therefore, strive for the practice of this Yoga of equanimity. Skill in action lies (in the practice of) this Yoga.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Even a little effort toward spiritual awareness will protect you from the greatest fear.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Even a little endeavor in practicing the regulative principles of bhakti-yoga protects one from the most dangerous type of fear.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Even if a man is full of love for others, he should act without attachment to the fruits of his actions.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Even if you are the most sinful of all sinners, yet you shall cross over all sin by the raft of knowledge.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Fear not. What is not real never was and never will be. What is real always was and cannot be destroyed.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: For him who has conquered the mind, the mind is the best of friends; but for one who has failed to do so, his mind will remain the greatest enemy.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: For him who has conquered the mind, the mind is the best of friends; but for one who has failed to do so, his very mind will be the greatest enemy.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: For one who has been honored, dishonor is worse than death.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: For one who has conquered his mind, a mind is best of friends, but for one who has failed to do so, a mind is the greatest enemy.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: For the unsteady there is no wisdom, and there is no meditation for the unsteady man.And for an un-meditated man, there is no peace. How can there be happiness for one without peace?
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Free from all thoughts of I’ and mine’, man finds absolute peace.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: From anger there comes delusion; from delusion, the loss of memory; from the loss of memory,the destruction of discrimination; and with the destruction of discrimination, he is lost.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: From the highest planet in the material world down to the lowest, all are places of misery wherein repeated birth and death take place. But one who attains to My abode, O son of Kunti, never takes birth again.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Go on efficiently doing your duty at all times without attachment.Doing work without attachment man attains the Supreme.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Hamaare saath jo hota hai usake lie ham svayan jimmedaar hain, chaahe ham yah samajh saken ya nahin ki kaise. isaka taatpary yah hai ki svayan ko badalakar hamaare saath jo hota hai use ham badal sakate hain; ham apane bhaagy ko apane haathon mein le sakate hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Hamesha mujhe dhyaan mein rakho, mujhe pooja karo, har kaam mujhe bhog dena, aur tum mujhe milega; yeh main vaada karta hoon; kyunki tum mujhe pyare ho.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Happiness from the senses seems like nectar initially, but it is bitter as poison in the end.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Happiness is a state of mind and has nothing to do with the external world.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who has let go of hatred, who treats all beings with kindness and compassion, who is always serene, unmoved by pain or pleasure.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who has no attachments can really love others, for his love is pure and divine.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who has no attachments can really love others, for his love is pure and divine. (2:64)
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who has renounced selfishness, who understands the principles of self-sacrifice and has realized that the true nature of the self is eternal, achieves cosmic consciousness and knows the spiritual truth.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who is able to resist the force of desire and anger before he quits his body is a yogi and is happy.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who is content with whatever comes, without attachment, not disappointed when he gets nothing, is wise.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who is devoid of attachment, who does not rejoice when he obtains good, nor lament when he obtains evil, is firmly fixed in perfect knowledge.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who is free from malice towards others and full of kindness, who is free from possessiveness and ego, is close to me.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who is rooted in oneness realizes that I am in every being; wherever he goes, he remains in Me.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who is satisfied with gain which comes of its own accord, who is free from duality and does not envy, who is steady in both success and failure, is never entangled, although performing actions.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who sees everyone as equal and looks upon everyone with an equal eye, whether in pleasure or in pain, is considered a perfect yogi.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who sees me everywhere and sees everything in me will not be lost to me, and I will not be lost to him.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who sees the self in all beings and all beings in the self, such a man of wisdom does not feel any hatred.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: He who thinks that the soul kills, and he who thinks of it as killed, are both ignorant. The soul kills not, nor is it killed.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: His judgment will be better and his vision clear if he is not emotionally entangled in the outcome of what he does.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Holding pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat as alike, gird yourself up for the battle. Thus, you shall not incur any sin.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: I am the same to all beings. I favor none, nor am I partial to anyone. I am the father of all and the same to all.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: If one offers Me with love and devotion a leaf, a ﬂower, a fruit or water, I will accept it.,
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: In fact all actions are being performed by the modes of Prakruti (Primordial Nature).The fool, whose mind is deluded by egoism, thinks:
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: In the heart of a person who is humble, patience, forgiveness, and devotion will naturally grow.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: In the still mind, in the depths of meditation, the Self reveals itself.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: In the stillness of a mind free from selfish desires, true love blossoms.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Insaan apne man ki mehnat se udhar ja sakta hai, ya niche khinch sakta hai, ek hi tarah se. Kyonki har ek insaan apne khud ka dost ya dushman hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Insaan apne vishvaas se banta hai. Jaisa wo vishvaas karta hai, waisa hi wo hota hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Insaan jab ‘main’ aur ‘mera’ ke sab soch se mukt ho jaata hai, toh usse sampurna shanti milti hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Isi prakaar geeta insaan ke bhagya ko poori tarah se insaan ke haath mein rakhta hai. Iska duniya nirdeshnik nahi hai, lekin yeh andhi kismat ka pradarshan bhi nahi hai: hum apne aap ko aur apne duniya ko kya maan kar, kya soch kar aur kya kar kar ke banate hain, chahe achhe ke liye ho ya bura ke liye.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Iss anitya duniya ko kisi tarah ki chhapti ya bhay ke bina milo, jeevan ke vikas mein bharosa rakho aur tum sachche shanti ko praapt karoge.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: It is better to engage in one’s own occupation, even though one may perform it imperfectly, than to accept another’s occupation and perform it perfectly.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: It is better to live your destiny imperfectly than to live an imitation of somebody else’s life with perfection.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: It is better to live your own destiny imperfectly than to live an imitation of somebody else’s life with perfection.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: It is better to strive in one’s own dharma than to succeed in the dharma of another.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jab aapaka man dvandv ke bhram par kaaboo pa lega, to aap sunee huee baaton aur sunee huee baaton ke prati pavitr udaaseenata kee sthiti praapt kar lenge.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jab chetana ekamev hoti hai, to fir sab bhranti-bhav chhod dete hain. Cheezein achchi ho ya buri, kisi cheez ka chinta karne ka koi sabab nahi hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jab dhyaan mein mahaarat haasil ho jaatee hai, to man hava rahit sthaan mein deepak kee lau kee tarah atal rahata hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jahaan bhi man bhatak raha ho, bechain aur bhed mein, apne se bahar ki khushi ke taarikh mein, usko andar le jao; usko aatma mein rahne ke liye taiyaar karo.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Janm hua toh mrityu jaroor hai, aur mrityu hui toh phir janm jaroor hai. Isliye jo antbhaav hai uske liye dukh na karo.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jis shakshak ne vishvas nahi kiya, uskey liye na to yeh duniya hai, na doosri duniya, na hi sukh.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jo hua, achchhe ke lie hua. jo ho raha hai, achchhe ke lie ho raha hai. jo hoga, vah bhee achchhe ke lie hoga.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jo log achhe kaam karte hain, unka bura ant nahi hoga, is duniya mein ya fir dusri duniya mein bhi nahi.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Jo log taamasik hain ve apana sukh nidra, aalasy aur nashe se praapt karate hain. praarambh aur ant donon mein, yah sukh ek bhram hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Josh, dhairy, ichchhaashakti, pavitrata vikasit karen; dvesh aur ghamand se bachen.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Just as a candle cannot burn without fire, men cannot live without a spiritual life.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Just as the ocean remains undisturbed by the incessant flow of waters from rivers merging into it, likewise the sage who is unmoved despite the flow of desirable objects all around him attains peace, and not the person who strives to satisfy desires.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Just try to learn the truth by approaching a spiritual master. Inquire from him submissively and render service unto him. The self-realised souls can impart knowledge unto you because they have seen the truth.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Kaama, krodh aur lobh, swarg se door karne waale trishukla dwar hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Karam aur phal, ek dusre ke dvandv anubhav ko lekar, aate aur jaate hain. Ye gyan tumhe sab kuchh sehlane mein madad karta hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Knowledge is the ultimate purification.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Kuchh log buddhi ke dwara dhyaan se man mein bhagwan ko dekhte hain; kuchh gyan ke yoga se; aur kuchh kaam ke yoga se. Kuchh log, bhramhan ko nahi samajhte, lekin dusron se sun kar puja karne lagte hain. Woh bhi sune hue cheez mein apne purn vishvaas se mrityu ko paar kar jaate hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Kuchh log jahaan bhi jaate hain, khushi phailaate hain, aur doosre jahaan bhi jaate hain, khushi paida karte hain!
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Left to itself, the mind goes on repeating the same old habitual patterns of personality. By training the mind, however, anyone can learn to step in and change old ways of thinking; that is the central principle of yoga.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Let your aim be the good of all. Then carry out your task in life with an unswerving devotion to truth, refusing to yield to selfish desires or to the errors of human nature.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Love and compassion are born from a state of selflessness and detachment.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Love is not a mere sentiment. It is the ultimate truth at the heart of creation.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Love is the bond that connects the finite to the infinite.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Lust, anger and greed, these are the three doors to self-destructive hell. Thus, one should avoid these.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Lust, anger, and greed are the three gates to self-destructive hell.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Make it easy for yourself. Get organized and live in the moment. Your day-to-day activities should not steal your happiness.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Man is bound by his own action except when it is performed for the sake of sacrifice.Therefore, Arjuna, efficiently perform your duty, free from attachment, for the sake of sacrifice alone.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Man is made by his belief. As he believes, so he is
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Man is made by his belief. As he believes, so he is.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Man is made by his beliefs. As he believes so he is.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Manushya apane vishvaas se banata hai. vah jaisa vishvaas karata hai, vaisa hee vah hota hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Meet this transient world with neither grasping nor fear, trust the unfolding of life and you will attain true serenity.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Mrityu kisi puraane coat ko utarne se jyada traumatic nahi hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Nidar aur shuddh rahen; apane drdh sankalp ya aadhyaatmik jeevan ke prati apane samarpan mein kabhee na dagamagaen. svatantr roop se den. aatm-niyantrit, eemaanadaar, sachche, premapoorn aur seva karane kee ichchha se bharapoor rahen.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Nishkama karma ek prakar ka tyaag hai, jisko sannyasa kahte hain; karma ka phalam tyaag karna dusra tyaag hai, jise tyaag kahte hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Nishkama karma mein sharan lo, aur aap dharmik gyaan ke dhan ko jama karenge. Jo log sirf karma ke phalon ki ichha se prabhavit hote hain, wo dukhi hain, kyunki wo apne kaam ke phal ke bare mein hamesha chinta mein rehte hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: No effort in this world is lost or wasted; a fragment of sacred duty saves you from great fear.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: No man can attain freedom from activity by refraining from action; nor can he reach perfection by merely refusing to act.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: No one who does good work will ever come to a bad end, either here or in the world to come.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: O mighty-armed son of Kunti, it is undoubtedly tough to curb the restless mind, but it is possible by constant practice and by detachment.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva attaches one to happiness, rajas to action, while tamas, covering up knowledge, leads to inadvertence also.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One must learn to tolerate them without being disturbed.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who can control his senses by practicing the regulated principles of freedom can obtain the complete mercy of the Lord and thus become free from all attachment and aversion.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who has control over the mind is tranquil in heat and cold, in pleasure and pain, and in honor and dishonor.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who has renounced attachment to the fruits of action, who is ever content, and free from all kinds of desires, does not act though he may be engaged in all kinds of actions.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who has wisdom and discernment is always calm and collected; such a person is in true knowledge.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who is able to withdraw the senses from their objects, as the tortoise withdraws its limbs, is firmly fixed in perfect consciousness.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who is able to withdraw the senses from their objects, just as a tortoise withdraws its limbs into its shell, is established in divine wisdom.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who is not disturbed by happiness and distress and is steady in both is certainly eligible for liberation.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who is not disturbed in mind amidst the threefold miseries or elated when there is happiness, and who is free from attachment, fear, and anger, is called a sage of steady mind.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who knows the transcendental nature of My appearance and activities does not, upon leaving the body, take his birth again in this material world, but attains My eternal abode, O Arjuna.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who neither hates nor desires the fruits of his activities is known to be always renounced. Such a person, free from all dualities, easily overcomes material bondage and is completely liberated, O mighty-armed Arjuna.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who performs his duty without attachment, surrendering the results unto the Supreme Lord, is unaffected by sinful action.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who performs their duty without attachment, surrendering the results unto the Supreme Lord, is unaffected by sinful actions, as the lotus lead is untouched by water.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is intelligent among men.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who shuns selfish attachment to the fruits of work and remains ever content and dependent on no one but himself – although engaged in all kinds of undertakings, such a person, O Prince, is said to be in the renounced order of life.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One who works in devotion, who is a pure soul, and who controls his mind and senses is dear to everyone, and everyone is dear to him. Though always working, such a man is never entangled.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One whose happiness is within, who is active and rejoices within, and whose aim is inward is actually the perfect mystic. He is liberated in the Supreme, and ultimately he attains the Supreme.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One, who after withdrawing the organs of action, sits mentally recollecting the objects of the senses, that one, of deluded mind, is called a hypocrite.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: One’s own duty, though devoid of merit, is preferable to the duty of another well performed.Even death in the performance of one’s own duty brings blessedness; another’s duty is fraught with fear.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Only when the mind is steady and still can one truly experience the depths of love.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Parivartan brahmaand ka niyam hai. aap ek pal mein karodapati ya kangaal ho sakate hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Peace begins when expectations end.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Perform all thy actions with mind concentrated on the Divine, renouncing attachment and looking upon success and failure with an equal eye.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Perform all work carefully, guided by compassion.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Perform your obligatory duty because action is indeed better than inaction.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Prthvee, jal, agni, vaayu, aakaash, man, buddhi aur ahankaar – ye meree prakrti ke aath vibhaag hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Raajasik vyakti oorja se bharapoor hota hai; taamasik vyakti sust, udaaseen, asanvedanasheel hota hai; saatvik vyakti shaant, saadhan sampann, dayaalu aur nisvaarth hota hai. phir bhee ye teenon hamesha jaagarookata ke kisee na kisee star par maujood hote hain, aur unaka anupaat badalata rahata hai: unaka paraspar kriya vyaktitv kee gatisheelata hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Renunciation of the fruits of action is better than meditation; meditation is better than knowledge; knowledge is better than performance of sacrifices.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Reshape yourself through the power of your will; never let yourself be degraded by self-will.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Saare bhog jo drishya jagat mein milte hain, unke aur toh shuruvat aur ant hota hai, lekin Krishna mein jo bhog milta hai, woh anant hai aur uske koi ant nahi hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Saare sukh jo drishya jagat mein milte hain, unke shuruvat aur ant hota hai, lekin Krishna mein jo sukh milta hai, woh anant hai aur uske koi ant nahi hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Seek refuge in the attitude of detachment and you will amass the wealth of spiritual awareness. Those who are motivated only by a desire for the fruits of action are miserable, for they are constantly anxious about the results of what they do.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Self-knowledge turns to ash all actions of dualities on your mind and brings you inner peace.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Set thy heart upon thy work, but never its reward.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Set thy heart upon thy work, but never on its reward.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Set thy heart upon thy work, but never on its reward. (My personal Favourite)
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Sever the ignorant doubt in your heart with the sword of self-knowledge. Observe your discipline. Arise.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Shanti, shantiyata, maun, samatvam, aur shuddhta: yeh man ke shaasan hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Shri Krishna said: One who is unattached to the fruits of his work and who works as he is obligated is in the renounced order of life, and he is the true mystic, not he who lights no fire and performs no duty.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Shri Krishna said: Son of Pṛthā, a transcendentalist engaged in auspicious activities does not meet with destruction either in this world or in the spiritual world; one who does good, My friend, is never overcome by evil.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Some people spread happiness wherever they go, others create happiness wherever they go!
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Some perceive God in the heart by the intellect through meditation; others by the yoga of knowledge; and others by the yoga of work. Some, however, do not understand Brahman, but having heard from others, take to worship. They also transcend death by their firm faith in what they have heard.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Soul is neither born, and nor does it die.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Sukha ek bhaav hai aur usme kisi bhee baahar ke baat ka koi lena dena nahi hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Sukha ki chabi ichchhaon ke kam karne mein hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: That man attains peace who, abandoning all desires, moves about without longing,without the sense of mine and without egoism.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: That one I love who is incapable of ill will, who is friendly and compassionate, living beyond the reach of ‘I’ and ‘mine,’ and of pleasure and pain.- 12.13
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: That person realizes peace who, relinquishing all desires, exists without craving and is unidentified with the mortal ego and its sense of mine-ness.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: That which is night to all beings, in that state (of divine knowledge and supreme bliss) the God-realized Yogi keeps awake. And that (the ever-changing, transient worldly happiness) in which all beings keep awake is night to the seer.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The disunited mind is far from wise; how can it meditate? How can it be at peace? When you know no peace, how can you know joy?
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The embodied soul is eternal in existence, indestructible, and infinite, only the material body is factually perishable.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The happiness which comes from long practice, which leads to the end of suffering, which at first is like poison, but at last like nectar – this kind of happiness arises from the serenity of one’s own mind.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The humble sages, by virtue of true knowledge, see with equal vision a learned and gentle brāhmaṇa, a cow, an elephant, a dog and a dog-eater [outcaste].
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The ignorant differentiate between spiritual knowledge and devotional service, but the wise see devotional service and knowledge as one.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The ignorant work for their own profit, Arjuna; the wise work for the welfare of the world, without thought for themselves.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The ignorant work for their own profit, the wise work for the welfare of the world.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The impermanent appearance of happiness and distress and their disappearance in due course are like the appearance and disappearance of winter and summer seasons. They arise from a sense of perception, and one must learn to tolerate them without being disturbed.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The key to happiness is the reduction of desires.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The meaning of Karma is in the intention. The intention behind action is what matters.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The mind is restless and difficult to control, but it can be conquered with practice and detachment.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The peace of God is with them whose mind and soul are in harmony, who are free from desire and wrath, who know their own soul.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The person is the same; he is simply experiencing the play of the gunas. As long as he identifies with his body and mind, he is at the mercy of this play.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The power of God is with you at all times; through the activities of mind, senses, breathing, and emotions; and is constantly doing all the work using you as a mere instrument.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The rajasic person is full of energy; the tamasic person is sluggish, indifferent, insensitive; the sattvic person, calm, resourceful, compassionate, and selfless. Yet all three are always present at some level of awareness, and their proportions change: their interplay is the dynamics of personality.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The self-controlled soul, who moves amongst sense objects, free from either attachment or repulsion, he wins eternal Peace.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The senses are superior to the gross body, and superior to the senses is the mind.Beyond the mind is the intellect, and even beyond the intellect is the soul.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The soul is neither born nor does it die.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The soul is neither born, and nor does it die. It just changes body just like we change clothes.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The soul is never born, it never dies having come into being once, it never ceases to be.Unborn, eternal, abiding and primeval, it is not slain when the body is slain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The struggle for self-mastery that every human being must wage if he or she is to emerge from life victorious.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The Supreme Lord said: I am mighty Time, the source of destruction that comes forth to annihilate the worlds. Even without your participation, the warriors arrayed in the opposing army shall cease to exist.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The supreme reality stands revealed in the consciousness of those who have conquered themselves. They live in peace, alike in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, praise and blame.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The truly wise mourn neither for the living nor for the dead.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The wise should work without attachment, for the welfare of the society.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The wise unify their consciousness and abandon attachment to the fruits of action.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The wise who knows the truth thinks, ‘I do nothing at all’; for in seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, sleeping, breathing, he thinks, ‘The senses move amongst the sense objects.'
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The wise, engaged in devotional service, take refuge in the Lord and free themselves from the cycle of birth and death by renouncing the fruits of action in the material world.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The wise, possessed of knowledge, having abandoned the fruits of their actions,and being freed from the fetters of birth, go to the place which is beyond all evil.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The yogi who is happy within, who rejoices within, and who is illuminated within, becomes fully liberated in the Brahman and attains the supreme eternal bliss.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: The yogis look upon all-well-wishers, friends, foes, the pious, and the sinners-with an impartial intellect. The yogi who is of equal intellect toward friend, companion, and foe, neutral among enemies and relatives, and unbiased between the righteous and sinful, is considered to be distinguished among humans.- 6.9
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: There are three gates leading to the hell of self-destruction for the soul-lust, anger, and greed. Therefore, one should abandon all three.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: There are three gates to this self-destructive hell: lust, anger, and greed. Renounce these three.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: There is neither this world nor the world beyond nor happiness for the one who doubts.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: There is neither this world, nor the world beyond, nor happiness for the one who doubts.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: There is no work that affects me, nor do I aspire for the fruits of action.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: There is nothing in the world as purifying as knowledge; one who has attained purity of heart through prolonged practice of karma yoga automatically sees the light of truth in the self in course of time.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Therefore the doubts which have arisen in your heart out of ignorance should be slashed by the weapon of knowledge. Armed with yoga, O Bhārata, stand and fight.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Therefore, do you perform your allotted duty; for action is superior to inaction. Desisting from action, you cannot even maintain your body.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: They are forever free who renounce all selfish desires and break away from the ego cage of ‘I,’ ‘me,’ and ‘mine’ to be united with the Lord.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: They live in wisdom who see themselves in all and all in them, who have renounced every selfish desire and sense craving tormenting the heart. (2:55-57)
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: This divine wisdom is a direct perception of the truth, much superior to any indirect knowledge of the scriptures or hearsay.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those established in Self-realization control their senses instead of letting their senses control them.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who are beyond the dualities that arise from doubts, whose minds are engaged within, who are always busy working for the welfare of all living beings and who are free from all sins achieve liberation in the Supreme.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who are disciplined in eating and recreation, balanced in work, and regulated in sleep, can mitigate all sorrows by practicing Yoga.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who are free from anger and all material desires, who are self-realised, self-disciplined and constantly endeavouring for perfection, are assured of liberation in the Supreme in the very near future.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who are free from anger and all material desires, who are self-realized, self-disciplined, and constantly endeavoring for perfection, are assured of liberation in the Supreme in the very near future.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who are free from anger and all material desires, who are self-realized, self-disciplined, and constantly endeavoring for perfection, are assured of liberation in the Supreme.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who are motivated only by desire for the fruits of action are miserable, for they are constantly anxious about the results of what they do.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who are tamasic draw their pleasures from sleep, indolence, and intoxication. Both in the beginning and in the end, this happiness is a delusion.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who see action in inaction and inaction in action are truly wise among humans.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those who see with eyes of knowledge the difference between the body and the knower of the body and can also understand the process of liberation from bondage in material nature, attain to the supreme goal.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Those whose minds are established in sameness and equanimity have already conquered the conditions of birth and death.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Through constant effort over many lifetimes, a person becomes purified of all selfish desires and attains the supreme goal of life.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Through selfless service, you will always be fruitful and find the fulfillment of your desires
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Thus the Gita places human destiny entirely in human hands. Its world is not deterministic, but neither is it an expression of blind chance: we shape ourselves and our world by what we believe and think and act on, whether for good or for ill.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: To action alone hast thou a right and never at all to its fruits; let not the fruits of action be thy motive; neither let there be in thee any attachment to inaction.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: To deliver the pious and to annihilate the miscreants, as well as to reestablish the principles of religion, I Myself appear, millennium after millennium.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: To refrain from selfish acts is one kind of renunciation, called sannyasa; to renounce the fruit of action is another, called Tyaga.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: To work alone you have the right, and not to the fruits. Do not be impelled by the fruits of work.Nor have attachment to inaction.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: True love does not expect anything in return, it gives freely and flows endlessly.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: True love is seeing the divine presence in every being.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: True love is to accept others as they are, without trying to control or possess them.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Tum un logon ke liye dukhi rahe ho jinke liye dukhi nahi hona chahiye, lekin tum sahi baat bhi bol rahe ho. Buddhiman log na toh marne waalo ke liye aur na hi jeene waalo ke liye dukhi hote hain.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Vyakti vahee hai; vah bas gunon ke khel ka anubhav kar raha hai. jab tak vah apane shareer aur man kee pahachaan karata hai, vah is khel kee daya par hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: We ourselves are responsible for what happens to us, whether or not we can understand how. It follows that we can change what happens to us by changing ourselves; we can take our destiny into our own hands.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: What is work and what is not work are questions that perplex the wisest of men.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Whatever a superior person does, another person does that very thing! Whatever he upholds as authority, an ordinary person follows that.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Whatever action is performed by a great man, common men follow in his footsteps.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Whatever happened, happened for the good. Whatever is happening, is happening for the good. Whatever will happen, will also happen for the good.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer or give away, and whatever austerities you perform – do that, O son of Kunti, as an offering to Me.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When a man gives up all desires that come to the mind, and rests contented in the Self by the Self, he is called a man of steady wisdom. (2:55)
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When a person is devoted to something with complete faith, I unify his faith in that.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When a person is devoted to something with complete faith, I unify his faith in that. Then, when his faith is completely unified, he gains the object of his devotion.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When a person responds to the joys and sorrows of others as if they were his own, he has attained the highest spiritual union.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When a person responds to the joys and sorrows of others as if they were his own, he has attained the highest state of spiritual union.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When consciousness is unified, however, all vain anxiety is left behind. There is no cause for worry, whether things go well or ill.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When love is rooted in selflessness, it brings peace and contentment.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When meditation is mastered, the mind is unwavering like the flame of a lamp in a windless place.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When you fall in love then your heart should fill with happiness, that does not come unless you surrender yourself completely
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When you let go of the need for control, you can feel the immense power of divine love flowing through you.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When you move amidst the world of sense, free from attachment and aversion alike, there comes the peace in which all sorrows end, and you live in the wisdom of the self.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When your intellect transcends the mire of delusion, then you will attain to dispassion of what has been heard and what is yet to be heard.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When your intellect, perplexed by what you have heard, shall stand immobile and steady in the self, then you shall attain self-realization.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: When your mind has overcome the confusion of duality, you will attain the state of holy indifference to things you hear and things you have heard.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Whenever and wherever there is a decline in religious practice, O descendant of Bharata, and a predominant rise of irreligion – at that time I descend Myself.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Wherever the mind wanders, restless and diffuse in its search for satisfaction without, lead it within; train it to rest in the Self.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: While contemplating on the objects of the senses, one develops attachment to them. Attachment leads to desire, and from desire arises anger.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: While seeing or hearing, touching or smelling; eating, moving about, or sleeping; breathing or speaking, letting go or holding on, even opening or closing the eyes, they understand that these are only the movements of the senses among sense objects.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Without ego-involvement and without getting entangled in whether things work out the way we want; only then will we not fall into the terrible net of karma. We cannot hope to escape karma by refraining from our duties: even to survive in the world, we must act.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Work done as a sacrifice for Vishnu has to be performed; otherwise, work binds one to this material world.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Yadi vah jo karata hai usake parinaam mein bhaavanaatmak roop se nahin ulajhata hai to usaka nirnay behatar hoga aur usakee drshti spasht hogee.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Yahi toh Gita ka kahna hai ki insaan ka bhagya uske apne haath mein hai. duniya koi nishchedhit nahi hai, aur na hi yeh andha sansaar hai. hum apne dharm ka uthaan karke aur sahi sochkar aur vyavahaar karke apne aap aur duniya ko banate hain, chahe achhe kaam ho ya bure kaam.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Yeh khushi jo lamba practice se aati hai, jo dukh ka nash kar deti hai, jo pahale vish jaise lagti hai, lekin baad mein amrit jaise lagti hai – yeh khushi apne man ke shanti se hoti hai.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Yeh swat-visheshakari narak ke teen darwaze hain: kama, krodh, aur lobh. In teeno ko tyaag do.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Yoga is skill in actions.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: Yoga is the journey of the self, through the self, to the self.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: You grieve for those who should not be grieved for, Yet you speak wise words. Neither for the dead nor those alive do the wise grieve for.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to thr fruits of your actions.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: You have the right to work but never to the fruit of work.
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: इन्द्रियइन्द्रिय (अर्थात् प्रत्येक इन्द्रिय) के विषय के प्रति (मन में) रागद्वेष रहते हैं मनुष्य को चाहिये कि वह उन दोनों के वश में न हो क्योंकि वे इसके (मनुष्य के) शत्रु हैं।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: इन्द्रियों के विषयों का चिंतन करते हुए मनुष्य उनमें आसक्त हो जाता है और आसक्ति कामना की ओर ले जाती है और कामना से क्रोध उत्पन्न होता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: इसलिए अज्ञान के कारण तुम्हारे हृदय में जो संदेह उत्पन्न हो गए हैं, उन्हें ज्ञान के शस्त्र से काट देना चाहिए। योग से सुसज्जित, हे भारत, खड़े होकर युद्ध करो।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: एक देहधारी प्राणी सभी कर्मों को नहीं त्याग सकता। परन्तु जो कर्मफल का त्याग कर देता है, वह सच्चा त्यागी कहलाता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: एक बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति दुख के स्रोतों में भाग नहीं लेता है, जो भौतिक इंद्रियों के संपर्क के कारण होते हैं। हे कुंती के पुत्र, ऐसे सुखों का आदि और अंत होता है, और इसलिए बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति उनसे प्रसन्न नहीं होता।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: एक व्यक्ति को योग में उन्नत कहा जाता है, जब सभी भौतिक इच्छाओं को त्याग कर, वह न तो इन्द्रियतृप्ति के लिए कार्य करता है और न ही सकारात्मक गतिविधियों में संलग्न होता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: और जब योगी सभी कल्मषों से मुक्त होकर, आगे की प्रगति करने के लिए सच्चे प्रयास में लग जाता है, तो अंतत: कई, कई जन्मों के अभ्यास के बाद, वह परम लक्ष्य को प्राप्त कर लेता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: और सभी योगियों में, जो महान आस्था के सा हमेशा मुझमें रहता है, अपने भीतर मेरे बारे में सोचता है और मुझे पारलौकिक प्रेमपूर्ण सेवा प्रदान करता है - वह योग में मेरे साथ सबसे घनिष्ठ रूप से जुड़ा हुआ है और सबसे ऊंचा है। यह मेरी राय है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: कछुवा अपने अंगों को जैसे समेट लेता है वैसे ही यह पुरुष जब सब ओर से अपनी इन्द्रियों को इन्द्रियों के विषयों से परावृत्त कर लेता है, तब उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर होती है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: कर्म करने मात्र में तुम्हारा अधिकार है, फल में कभी नहीं। तुम कर्मफल के हेतु वाले मत होना और अकर्म में भी तुम्हारी आसक्ति न हो।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: कर्मों के न करने से मनुष्य नैर्ष्कम्य को प्राप्त नहीं होता और न कर्मों के संन्यास से ही वह पूर्णत्व प्राप्त करता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: काम, क्रोध और लोभ, ये आत्मविनाश के नरक के तीन द्वार हैं। अतः इन तीनों का त्याग करना चाहिए।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: किसी आध्यात्मिक गुरु के पास जाकर सत्य को जानने का प्रयास करें। उससे विनम्रतापूर्वक पूछें और उसकी सेवा करें। आत्मसाक्षात्कारी आत्माएँ आपको ज्ञान प्रदान कर सकती हैं क्योंकि उन्होंने सत्य को देखा है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: क्रोध से उत्पन्न होता है मोह और मोह से स्मृति विभ्रम। स्मृति के भ्रमित होने पर बुद्धि का नाश होता हैऔर बुद्धि के नाश होने से वह मनुष्य नष्ट हो जाता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: जन्मने वाले की मृत्यु निश्चित है और मरने वाले का जन्म निश्चित है इसलिए जो अटल है अपरिहार्य है उसके विषय में तुमको शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: जिसका आनंद भीतर है, जो सक्रिय है और भीतर आनंदित है, और जिसका लक्ष्य भीतर है, वह वास्तव में पूर्ण रहस्यवादी है। वह परम में मुक्त हो जाता है, और अंततः वह परम को प्राप्त करता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: जिसने मन को जीत लिया है, उसके लिए मन सबसे अच्छा मित्र है; लेकिन जो ऐसा करने में असफल रहा है, उसके लिए उसका मन सबसे बड़ा शत्रु बना रहेगा।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: जैसे मनुष्य जीर्ण वस्त्रों को त्यागकर दूसरे नये वस्त्रों को धारण करता हैवैसे ही देही जीवात्मा पुराने शरीरों को त्याग कर दूसरे नए शरीरों को प्राप्त होता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: जैसे सम्पूर्ण नदियोंका जल चारों ओरसे जलद्वारा परिपूर्ण समुद्रमें आकर मिलता है पर समुद्र अपनी मर्यादामें अचल प्रतिष्ठित रहता है। ऐसे ही सम्पूर्ण भोगपदार्थ जिस संयमी मनुष्यमें विकार उत्पन्न किये बिना ही उसको प्राप्त होते हैं वही मनुष्य परमशान्तिको प्राप्त होता है भोगोंकी कामनावाला नहीं।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: जो अपने आप होने वाले लाभ से संतुष्ट है, जो द्वैत से मुक्त है और ईर्ष्या नहीं करता, जो सफलता और विफलता दोनों में स्थिर है, वह कर्म करते हुए भी कभी नहीं बँधता।
author: Bhagavad Gita

quote: जो आत्मा को मारने वाला समझता है और जो इसको मरा समझता है वे दोनों ही नहीं जानते हैं,क्योंकि यह आत्मा न मरता है और न मारा जाता है।
author: Bhagavad Gita
