quote: Knowledge is proud that he has learned so much; Wisdom is humble that he knows no more.
author: William Cowper

quote: Wisdom is not in words; it is in understanding.
author: Rumi

quote: Better weight than wisdom a traveler cannot carry.
author: The Havamal

quote: Applicants for wisdom, do what I have done: Inquire within.
author: Heraclitus

quote: We can be knowledgeable with other men’s knowledge but we cannot be wise with other men’s wisdom.
author: Montaigne

quote: The more sand that has escaped from the hourglass of our life, the clearer we should see through it.
author: Jean Paul

quote: The first point of wisdom is to discern that which is false; the second to know that which is true.
author: Lactanius

quote: It is not white hair that engenders wisdom.
author: Menander

quote: Where fear is present, wisdom cannot be.
author: Lactantius

quote: With men of understanding, wisdom counts for everything...
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.
author: The Book of Proverbs

quote: A short saying often contains much wisdom.
author: Sophocles

quote: Life is the only real counselor; wisdom unfiltered through personal experience does not become a part of the moral tissue.
author: Edith Wharton

quote: Besides the noble art of getting things done, there is the noble art of leaving things undone. The wisdom of life consists in the elimination of non- essentials.
author: Lin Yutang

quote: We learn wisdom from failure much more than from success.
author: Samuel Smiles

quote: Learn wisdom from the ways of a seedling. A seedling which is never hardened off through stressful situations will never become a strong productive plant.
author: Stephen Sigmund

quote: These days people seek knowledge, not wisdom. Knowledge is of the past, wisdom is of the future.
author: Vernon Cooper

quote: From the errors of others, a wise man corrects his own.

quote: Shallow men believe in luck, wise and strong men in cause and effect.

quote: Those who aren’t affected by impurities are sages.
author: Bodhidharma

quote: Wise men who see reality will give you knowledge.
author: The Bhagavad Gita

quote: A word to the wise is sufficient.
author: Terence

quote: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you.
author: The Book of Proverbs

quote: The wise wake up. They choose reason over custom.
author: Bodhidharma

quote: Wise men store up knowledge...
author: The Book of Proverbs

quote: He who knows others is wise; he who knows himself is enlightened.

quote: The wise man acts toward all beings even as towards himself.
author: The Mahabharata

quote: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge; the ears of the wise seek it out.
author: The Book of Proverbs

quote: The sage increases his wisdom by all that he can gather from others.

quote: A wise person becomes full of goodness even if one gathers it little by little.

quote: Who is a wise man? He who learns of all men.

quote: The wise learn many things from their foes.
author: Aristophanes

quote: A single conversation with a wise man is worth a month’s study of books.

quote: A wise man though possessed of immense perfections, will learn from others.

quote: He is wise who learns at another’s expense.

quote: The wise are joyful in the truth revealed by the noble ones.

quote: The wise person possesses humility.

quote: The wise and the brave dares own that he was wrong.

quote: The good and wise lead quiet lives.

quote: The wise man will want to be ever with him who is better than himself.
author: Plato

quote: The wise person possesses humility.
author: Harold C. Chase

quote: The man who questions opinion is wise; the man who quarrels with fact is a fool.

quote: The wise man does not expose himself needlessly to danger.

quote: The wise man thinks about his troubles only when there is some purpose in doing so...

quote: The wise man forgets insults as the ungrateful forget benefits.
author: Chinese Proverb

quote: A wise man, to accomplish his end, may even carry his foe on his shoulders.
author: Panchatantra

quote: No man was ever wise by chance.

quote: Even as a solid rock is unshaken by the wind, so are the wise unshaken by praise or blame.
author: The Dhammapada

quote: That man alone is wise who remains master of himself.
author: Confucius

quote: The wise enter with great care...scout out the hidden...Go slowly...Let foresight feel the way, and let caution determine the ground.
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: The wise live among people, but are indifferent to their praise or blame.
author: Chuang Tzu

quote: Ordinary people are friendly with those who are outwardly similar to them. The wise are friendly with those who are inwardly similar to them.
author: Lieh Tzu

quote: The wise stand out, because they see themselves as part of the Whole. They shine, because they don’t want to impress. They achieve great things, because they don’t look for recognition. author: Lao Tzu

quote: A man of wisdom is independent, with a free, enriched mind, who gives and shares happiness with others. A man of wisdom is the one who always has an attitude of appreciation and tries to express his kindness and gratitude to everybody.
author: Kazumi Tabata

quote: The wise man knows nothing if he cannot benefit from his wisdom.
author: Cicero

quote: You are a wise person if you can easily direct your attention to whatever needs it.

quote: In the whole of history there has never existed a single person whose conduct was always perfect. Understanding this, the wise don’t try to be perfect.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: The wise man reads both books and life itself.
author: Lin Yutang

quote: The wise don’t abandon Tao just because no one notices how wise they are. It is their nature to be the way they are.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: For never, never, wicked man was wise.
author: Homer

quote: Wise people, even though all laws were abolished, would still lead the same life.
author: Aristophanes

quote: The wise establish virtue firmly within themselves, and are honored for generations to come.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: A person of wisdom should be truthful, without arrogance, without deceit, not slanderous and not hateful. The wise person should go beyond the evil of greed and miserliness.
author: Buddha

quote: The wise utterly devote themselves to everything in which they partake, every situation which contains them and within which they evolve.
author: Chuang Tzu

quote: The art of being wise is the art of knowing what to overlook.
author: William James

author: Mark Twain

author: André Gide

author: Sigmund Freud

author: Miyamoto Musashi

author: Confucius

author: William Faulkner

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Being a seeker means no matter what the Vedas said, what Krishna or Shiva said, you have to know the truth in your own experience.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: It is not because there is God that devotion has come; because there is devotion, there is God.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you ask a tree how he feels to know that he's spreading his fragrance and making people happy, I don't think a tree looks at it that way. I am just like that, and it is just my nature to be like this.

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Time and space are just projections of your consciousness.

quote: Once your mind becomes absolutely still, your intelligence transcends human limitations.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Life has come from a very beautiful source. If you remain in touch with that source, everything about you will be beautiful.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: All thoughts are just junk. Essentially, they are coming from the limited experience of past. These thoughts are useful for your survival process. author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: People call books holy, but they are yet to realize that life is holy.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Devotion means who you are should merge with what you are doing. Otherwise, whatever your activity may be, it will not be of any great significance.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you don't invest your life in what you really care for, your life will be wasted. You will not fly - you will just drag yourself through life.

quote: Yoga means to unite the limited with the unlimited.Devotion means a profusion of life.

quote: Seeing everything just the way it is gives you the power and capability to walk through life effortlessly.

quote: What is the meaning of life? It is too great a phenomenon to fit into any meaning.

quote: It would be wonderful if this world was guided by little children, because they are closer to life than anyone else.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The roots of the Divine are entrenched in this body. If you nurture the roots, how can you avoid the flowering?

quote: Once you touch a dimension which is boundless, the idea of time and space disappears. What is here is there; what is there is here.

quote: Mind is madness. Only when you go beyond the mind, there will be meditation.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: In spirituality, when we say growth, we are talking about becoming smaller; not just smaller - non-existent.

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: You do not have to pursue something intensely; you as a being should become very intense.

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The moment you ascribe who you are right now to what happened yesterday, you have written off your life.

quote: Ganapati, the one with the human body and the head of a Gana, became a tremendous possibility.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Being spiritual is a far more intelligent way to exist. It means being in tune with the intelligence of the Creator.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Meditation is not an act, it is a quality. Meditation is not something that you do - it is something that you become.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Knowing yourself has to always come from within. The outside can inspire or guide you, but knowing has to come from within you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Responsibility means being able to respond to whatever situation you may face in your life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When a child enters your life it's time to learn [not time to teach].

quote: If you want to be successful, don't seek success - seek competence, empowerment; do nothing short of the best that you can do.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Once you have access to the source of creation within you, your health and wellbeing will naturally be taken care of.

quote: Your intelligence is so deeply entangled with the social identification that you have taken on, your brains are not working in line with the life within you; it is working against your own life. That is the source of misery.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: No work is stressful. It is your inability to manage your body, mind, and emotions that makes it stressful.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: It is possible for every human being to be blissful, if you are willing to pay a little attention to how this human mechanism functions.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: A child is a life that has not gone too far away from the Creator. Know a child to know life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If thinking minds, questioning minds, doubting minds, are talking about faith, their whole life will become fake.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The moment you function in the world without being concerned about what is happening to life around you, you are a Criminal.

quote: Devotion is the spark that can fire up your chemistry and energy to such a level that it creates an explosion of ecstasy within you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Knowledge can only be limited. Ignorance is boundless. In recognizing our ignorance, we will touch that which is boundless.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Meditation means ultimate freedom within you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When you absolutely throw yourself into your activity, your energy will only grow.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Intelligence is of paramount importance to live life sensibly, because without intelligence, there is no clarity. And Clarity is intelligence everyone is capable of.

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Most of your desires are not really about yourself. You just picked them up from your social surroundings.

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: People try to create an outwardly perfect life, but the quality of life is based on the inward.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you did not have any personality, you would have a tremendous presence. The more rigid your personality, the more constipated your whole being.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Destiny is the result of all your actions and the impressions that you have taken in.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: We neither need a political revolution nor a religious revolution. What we need is an inner transformation in human beings.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: No two individuals are ever the same. You cannot equate people. You can only create equal opportunity.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: There is no need to make spirituality a part of education. If you make education non-imposing and non-suppressive, people are naturally spiritual.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The best thing that you can do to this world is to be joyous. Being joyful, is the greatest offering you can make to the world.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Seeking means admitting that you do not know. Once you have cleared your slate, truth can imprint itself upon it.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: In this culture, God is not the highest entity; mukti or liberation is the highest goal. We are willing to use God as a stepping stone, if needed.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: On the spiritual path, the first thing is to experientially ascertain where your are right now. You can only start the journey from where you are.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: We think there is an ecological problem, but the real problem is irresponsible growth of human population.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Integrity is not about the action but its purpose. Are you doing it for everyone's wellbeing or for your own benefit?
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you dissolve your personality, your presence becomes very powerful - this is the essence of spiritual sadhana.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If we do not work for individual transformation, talking about world peace is just entertainment.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: There is only one calamity: ignorance. And there is only one solution: enlightenment.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Yoga means union, that in your experience, everything has become one.

quote: The methods and technologies of how to experience that which is beyond the physical is what is known as the science of yoga is a longing. Only when your longing is cranked up to peak intensity, knowing becomes a possibility.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you cultivate your body, your mind, your emotions, and your energies to a certain level of maturity, meditation will blossom.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Generally, people who are not self-realized are full of themselves. One who is self-realized sees that the whole world is full of one.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Devotion is when your involvement with life is so absolute that you yourself do not matter anymore.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Death is not a disaster. Too many births - that is the real disaster.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Having a good home, eating good food, wearing good clothes, are a means to living well; they are not the goals of our life. The quality of your life is decided by how peaceful and joyful you are.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: What you see as cosmos is a living mind - intelligent space.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Pleasure is just a shadow of joy. When there is no joy in you, you become a pleasure seeker.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Devotion is not about a God. Devotion is about you making your emotions so sweet that your life experience becomes beautiful.

author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Sadhana is towards creating a sense of inner fulfillment, where there is no need to lean on anyone anymore.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When who you are and what you are is not decided by any external forces, then you are in dignity.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Any method to heighten the presence of that which is the source of creation within you, is yoga.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Unless you are oblivious to your own suffering, you have no right to be oblivious to other people's suffering.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The cosmos is a complex amalgamation of sounds. One of the key sounds through which you can experience the cosmic nature of creation is Shambho.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The very purpose of life is to reach the highest possible flowering.A Guru is not someone who holds a torch for you. He is the torch.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Making conclusions about life is a sure way to deny yourself the possibility of a human being transforming himself into the Divine.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Meditation means to awaken new dimensions within you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Spirituality is ultimate greed. You don't just want a piece of creation - you want the source of creation.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Awareness means grasping life just the way it is, without contamination by mental projections.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Devotion is a place where you do not exist; life just flows through you as a certain sweetness and beauty.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: We don't need more Hindus, more Christians, or more Muslims - we need more Buddhas, more Jesuses, and more Krishnas - then there will be true change. Every human being has that inner potential.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The source of creation is within you. You can be just a piece of flesh, or you can be the Creator himself - this is the choice and potential you have.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The physical is only a small aspect of existence. In this cosmos, not even 1% is physical - the rest is non-physical.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you do a yoga that does not change the patterns of energy within you, I would say, don't waste your time on it.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Faith is not something that you can cultivate. If it happens to you, it happens, if it doesn't happen to you it doesn't happen, that's all. Does it mean to say - 'I have to just sit and wait and someday it will fall upon me?' No, it is just that if you understand the fundamentals of living here, in this existence, you will see, for anything to happen, you must create the right kind of situation.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The very way you breathe, sit, stand, eat, walk, work - everything can become yoga. You can use any process of life to transcend your limitations.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If we are not sensible about this, in our ideas of wealth creation we may completely destroy the planet - which we are already doing in many ways.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Intelligence essentially means that your intellect is sharp enough to see life the way it is.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Spirituality is not about becoming special - it is about becoming one with everything.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: You have the choice to be here as a speck of creation or as the very source of creation. Not exploring such a phenomenal possibility is a crime.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Meditation is the nourishment for flowering.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you want the Divine to become alive within you, first of all you as a human being have to become absolutely alive.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: You cannot be receptive when you are too full of yourself. The less you are, the more you receive. The more you are, the less you receive.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: There is no such thing as having attained enough. Life is an endless possibility.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: A devotee has no agenda of his own. For him, the object of devotion is everything.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Water has memory. Depending on how you treat it, what kind of thoughts and emotions you generate, accordingly it behaves in your body.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Any teaching will not transform you as long as you are deeply attached to your body. Yoga is towards reducing this attachment.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Whatever your goal in life, unless you develop a great urgency, what could be near will be far away.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Devotion is a tool to dissolve yourself into nothingness and become the very hand of the Divine.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: For integrity to flourish in society, we have to nurture it - within ourselves, in our children, in our education systems.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Karma is your survival and your bondage. And if you handle it right, it can also be your liberation.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When meditation makes you realize that you have so many limitations of your own and they are all created by you, the longing to break them will come.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When you are truly meditative, there is no time and space for you. Time and space is just a creation of the mind.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Being attached to someone is not about the other person. It is about your own sense of inadequacy.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: In yoga, you never chase an experience - you only prepare for it.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: This is a technology where without external input, you create a chemistry of blissfulness within you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The sign of intelligence is that you are constantly wondering. Idiots are always dead sure about every damn thing they are doing in their life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: As long as you are a part of the physical process of the existence, there is nothing that does not change.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: We neither need a political revolution nor a religious revolution. What we need is an inner transformation in human beings.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: There is a region beyond reason. Unless you get there, you will not know the sweetness of love, nor the Divine.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you knew the immensity of what it means to be human, you would not talk about God or Heaven.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you can break the illusion that you are separate and begin to experience the oneness of the existence, that is yoga.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Spiritual process is not about chanting a mantra or closing your eyes, spiritual process is essentially about enhancing your perception.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Life is not outside of you. You are life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: A human being is like a seed. Either you can keep it as it is, or you can make it grow into a wonderful tree with flowers and fruits.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Believing that what you do not know cannot exist is the crown of ignorance.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Confidence without clarity is always a disaster.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: One who is constantly resting within himself is capable of endless activity.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Without being in constant exchange with the rest of the cosmos, you cannot exist. The idea of individuality is an illusion.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Once there is a distance between you and your thought process, a new freedom is born. With this freedom, a new perception arises.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Yoga is the journey from just eating and sleeping to becoming an ecstatic being. This is the aspiration of life itself.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The most beautiful moments in life are moments when you are expressing your joy, not when you are seeking it.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: For the sort of potential that a human being carries, it is a very brief life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you seek security in life, unknowingly you seek death. The only truly secure place is your grave.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: I don't have opinions. Only if it is necessary for a particular action, I make a judgment. Opinions are fetters for your intelligence.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you know how to keep yourself pleasant within, irrespective of what is happening around you, Ultimate Liberation cannot be denied to you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Meditation is that dimension of science which focuses on creating the right kind of interior, so that you can live a peaceful and joyous life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Whether it is your work, your love, or your life - unless you throw your entire self into it, you will never know what it is.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Higher dimensions of Awareness means higher dimensions of energy.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you have no agenda of your own, life will work according to its agenda. Your personal agenda is taking you further and further away from that.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: As a leader, you build trust when you give yourself 100%, so that people understand with your every action, you stand for them.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: A spiritual process is not a divorce from life. It is an irrevocable love affair with life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: For wealth to translate into wellbeing, you need a spiritual element within you. Without that, your success will work against you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you become so intensely curious that without knowing you cannot live, that is called seeking.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Yoga is not just about living better. It is about exploring the very source of life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: 'God' is just a name to refer to something that is beyond all limitations.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: I am not talking about you being a spectator, I am talking about involvement. I am talking about involving yourself into life in such a way that you dissolve into it.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: What you call intelligence and what you refer to as the Creator are not different. The Creator is pure intelligence, intelligence beyond logic.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Your thoughts and emotions are the drama that you create in your mind. You must be able to end it somewhere.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Life and death are like inhalation and exhalation. They always exist together.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you pay sufficient attention, everything in life is magnificent, everything is a doorway to the Divine.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Meditation means to know life beyond the sphere of the physical; to know and experience life not just at the surface but at the source.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: For the Divine to function through you, it is important to make every breath, every pulsation in the body, and your very existence an offering.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Nothingness is the basis of everything.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Incredible things can be done simply if we are committed to making them happen.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The most enduring sort of power is realizing the power within.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Self-transformation is not just about changing yourself. It means shifting yourself to a completely new dimension of experience and perception.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Your personality is something that you created. Once you are aware of that, you could create it whichever way you want.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you walk through life with ease and without any sense of entanglement, that is maturity.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When one is overfed and another one is hungry, I call that a disaster.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If anyone steps on your ego, instantly, he becomes your enemy. But a Guru is a friend who constantly tramples your ego.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Once you realize that the way you exist right now is not enough, that there is something more, your spiritual process has already begun.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When every moment, you experience yourself as the source of creation, not as a piece of creation, then you are realized.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Spirituality is a boundless ability to respond and experience.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: With wrong farming methods, we turn fertile land into desert. Unless we go back to organic farming and save the soil, there is no future.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The first step towards knowing is to see that you do not know.All beliefs will crash somewhere. Only reality will sustain itself.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Your ideas need not have anything to do with reality. Making conclusions is a sure way of not enhancing our perception.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Consciousness is not a bunch of thoughts or a certain level of understanding. Consciousness is a dimension that is beyond our physicality.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Do not talk about the soul, heaven, or God. Talking about something that is not yet a reality for you amounts to falsehood.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Being spiritual does not mean being dead serious. If you allow life to happen within you exuberantly, unbridled, you will touch the spirit.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Spiritual process is not for the dead or the dying; it is for the living who want to become fully alive in all dimensions of life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Meditation means to go beyond the limitations of body and mind.If you try to live that which is past, that which IS will bypass you.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: O' the blue-bodied cowherd - ever playful in love and war. Don't you fail to see the immensity of his wisdom and light.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The only reason why you are unhappy is because you are trying to be happy.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Detachment does not mean non-involvement. You can be deeply involved but not entangled.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: A consecrated space experientially reminds you that there is much more to life than you think.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Whether it is suffering or joy, going through experiences in life is not so much of a karma. Depriving yourself of any experience is the big karma.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Life is fluid, ever evolving. The more dynamic you are, the more happens in your life, all the time.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you just live totally, you will dissolve lots of karma. Living totally means that you experience anything that comes fully and intensely.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: With yoga, not only your body should become flexible - your mind and emotions, and above all your consciousness should become flexible.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The Divine is constantly waiting at your doorstep to move in if only you allow the necessary space.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Yoga is a way to produce a chemistry of blissfulness. Once you are blissful by your own nature, you can deal with outside situations effortlessly.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Only in unawareness you are mortal. In awareness you are immortal.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: All along, you've been shaping your destiny unconsciously. But you can also work on it consciously. If you make the effort to access your core and realise that everything is your responsibility, and shift your focus inside you, then you can rewrite your destiny.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Destiny is what every human being creates for oneself. Fate is when you fail to create your own destiny.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The mind remembers only certain things. The body remembers everything. The information it carries goes back to the beginning of existence.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: A guru is not a crutch, he is a bridge.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Without raising human consciousness, whatever we do in the world will only lead to more and more suffering.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Frustration, discouragement, and depression mean you are working against yourself.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: We are eating, using up, and possessing more than we should. That is why a large portion of the human population is hungry.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Most of the time you are thinking about life, not living life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you shift from compulsiveness to consciousness, being joyful will not be an effort.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The spiritual process has always been referred to as a journey - constant change.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Today, it is more important than ever to raise human consciousness, so that technology becomes a means of empowerment, not destruction.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Looking at everything through your phone is only numbing your perception - it does not really enhance your experience of life in any way.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Devotion is about you. Maybe you use another object as inspiration, but you change your quality; you walk more joyfully, gently upon this planet.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If your energy body is in full vibrancy, the physical body will naturally fix itself.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Plain intellectual thinking is the peak of ignorance because all that you will know is to play with a few aspects and make others look like fools.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: A materialistic person is ruthless with other people but kind to himself. A spiritual person is ruthless with himself but kind to everybody else.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Whatever happens - ultimately, life corrects itself.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The very life within you is longing to be joyful because joyfulness is the nature of the source of creation.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The hand of the Creator is actively involved in every atom, every plant, every creature, and yourself, in every cell in your body.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Karma means ultimate responsibility. You even take responsibility for your genetics.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When you do something just because it is needed, you involve yourself totally without it meaning anything to you, then action becomes liberating.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Your ability to love, to reach out, and to experience life is limitless. The limitation is only of the body and mind.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: What we refer to as yoga is just a technology to make your energies function by choice, not by compulsion.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you think you are big, you will become small. If you are willing to become an absolute nothing, you will become larger than creation and Creator.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Gossip is a kind of misalignment with people around you. You can either gossip about everyone, or you can become one with everyone.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If we transform our population into a trained, focused, balanced and inspired population, India will be a miracle.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Transformation means nothing of the old should remain; something absolutely new should happen.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The science and technology of how this life functions and what we can do with it, is what we refer to as yoga.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Bhakti yoga is a way of transforming your emotion from negativity to utmost pleasantness.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you want to really know higher dimensions of life, there needs to be a constant sense of peacefulness and joyfulness within you
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you want to find out the purpose of life, you need to look beyond the limitations of body and mind.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: How Human beings are, that is how the society will be. So, creating human beings who are flexible and willing to look at everything rather than being stuck in their ideas and opinions definitely makes for a different kind of society. And the very energy that such human being carry will influence everything around them.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When you exist here only as a body and a mind, suffering is inevitable.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Confusion is better than stupid conclusions. In confusion, there is still a possibility. In stupid conclusion, there is no possibility.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: To be spiritual means to be an emperor within yourself. This is the only way to be.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you think one thing is sacred but you cannot stand the other, if you love the Creator but hate the creation, that is vulgarity.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The most fundamental and the most important aspect of the spiritual process can in no way be stopped by anybody - except yourself.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Only when man is willing to change himself, there can be a true revolution.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you are truly a seeker of truth, truth cannot hide from you. It is in the lap of truth that you have happened.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Devotion as an act is vulgar. Devotion as a way of life is wonderful. If you are a great devotee, it is ugly. If you are devout, it is beautiful.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: If you see there is no meaning to anything that you are doing, your ego collapses; so you are trying to find all kinds of fake meanings.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Being on the spiritual path means you want to be a success in an existential sphere, not just on a social level.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: What is most needed right now is evolving human consciousness. Without that, science, technology, development, everything will go waste.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: When you do not know how to handle yourself, where is the need to produce another life.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: It is the pain of ignorance which makes one into a seeker.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: Modern science has its value in terms of utility, but it cannot open up existence to human experience.”.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev

quote: The Mind is a powerful instrument. Every thought, every emotion that you create changes the very chemistry of your body.
author: Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev
